acceptanceCriteria: A deterministic test reproduces or rules out the stale-starting-child race after a kept LOCK_TIMEOUT relaunch.
If reproduced, the relaunch yields a single coherent result (or a named refusal), never an exit 1 without a result; the ATR spec records the failure mode.
body: Suspected, not confirmed. Residual from the V1-1671 fix (PR #1095, ATR-V0-095, internal/tasks/cli/lease_detach.go). When a launcher died before recording its child (ATR-V0-021), that stale starting child can take the `running` lock after the new launcher moves result.json and relaunches without the ATR-V0-027 liveness check. The store replay keeps the mutation exactly once, but the new child exits 1 without a result, so the attach reports a failure with no result document. No test covers it.

completion.reason: DONE per 2026-10-21 v1-0 ticket audit, independently verified against origin/main ef2a01db5: 3438822f4; internal/tasks/cli/lease_detach_relaunch_test.go:141. race ruled out by deterministic test

title: SUSPECTED: detach relaunch after a kept LOCK_TIMEOUT can race a stale starting child (ATR-V0-021 hazard after ATR-V0-095)
